invalidJsonBody.where: Chart scraper dialog: error when the scrape request body could not be read

messagesRequired.where: Chart scraper dialog (web search chat): error when the request had no chat messages

searchDefaultReply.where: Chart scraper dialog (web search chat): assistant's reply shown above search results when the AI gave no text of its own

searchFailed.where: Chart scraper dialog (web search chat): error when the web search failed

scrapeFetchStatus.where: Library, chord-chart scraper: error when the web page answered with an error
scrapeFetchStatus.context: {detail} is the web server's status text in English (e.g. 'Not Found'); leave it as is.

scrapeFetchFailed.where: Library, chord-chart scraper: error when the web page could not be reached
scrapeFetchFailed.context: {detail} is a technical error message in English; leave it as is.

scrapeInputRequired.where: Library, chord-chart scraper: error when neither a web address nor pasted text was sent
scrapeInputRequired.context: 'url' and 'rawText' are the request's field names; translate the sentence as 'a web address or pasted text is required'.

scrapeNoChart.where: Library, chord-chart scraper: error when the page has no chord chart
scrapeNoChart.context: 'rawText' is the paste-text field; in the app the person can paste the chart's text instead.

scrapeFailed.where: Library, chord-chart scraper: error when reading the chart from the page failed
scrapeFailed.context: {detail} is a technical error message in English; leave it as is. 'chart' = chord chart (sheet music).
